en: Soldier. Head amber brown, elongate cylindrical with parallel sides and broadly rounded hind corners; the last abdominal tergite is more heavily sclerotized and darker. In profile the frontal dorsal corners are slightly raised and the declivity about forty-five degrees, the frons shallowly V-depressed with several faint longitudinal striae; the eyes are visible and lie closer to the antennal sockets than their own transverse diameter. Labrum short and rounded with a truncate margin. Mandibles short and stout, strongly curved apically, the left less than half the head length. Antennae twelve segmented. Postmentum six to seven times as long as the waist, its broad trapezoidal part in the anterior third. Pronotum narrower than the head.
soldier: 兵蚁头壳呈琥珀般的褐色，上颚黑褐，上唇、触角与眼点褐，前胸背板黄褐，腹部淡黄褐，第十腹背板后半部几丁质化较强而色深，足与头壳同为褐色或稍浅。头壳长圆柱形，两侧平行，后侧角宽圆；侧面观额背角稍隆，额坡约四十五度，额面呈V形浅凹，中央有数条浅纵纹，Y形缝隐约，复眼可见，其与触角窝的距离小于眼的横径。上唇略作短圆形，唇端平；上颚短壮而末端较弯，左上颚短于头壳之半。触角十二节。后颏长为腰狭处的六至七倍，宽区在前方三分之一，呈梯形，颏前部两侧微向内凹，前缘后方低陷并具数条横纹；腰区位于后部三分之一，后缘弧凸。前胸背板窄于头，前缘浅凹而中央微缺切，两侧缘缓缓斜向后，后缘中央稍向前凹，中线色淡而下凹。
